chapter.verse: Tuili gal khat Gerasa gamah a tung uh a,
Zeisu in gunkuang sung pan a pusuah khit ciangin, thakhatin a kihhuai dawi lutpa khat in han lak panin a dawn hi.
Tua pa omna in han lak ahi hi. Kuamah in amah sikkhau nangawn tawh a hen zo kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, kolbulh leh sikkhau tawh tamveipi a kihen ngei hangin sikkhau a peeksat a, kolbulh a kuai tan hi; kuamah in amah a zo zo kei hi.
Sun leh zan a tawntungin han lakah ahi zongin, mualtung ah ahi zongin kiko a, suang tawh a pumpi a kikuisak hi.
A gamla pan Zeisu a muh ciangin a kiangah tai a, bokin,
“A sang bel Pasian’ Tapa Zeisu aw, nang tawh bang kikum i hi hiam? Kei nong bawlsiat loh nadingin, Pasian’ min tawh thu kong pia hi!” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
Hih thu bang hangin a gen hiam i cih leh, “Kihhuai dawi aw, tua mipa sung pan taikhia in,” ci-in Zeisu in thu a pia zo hi.
Zeisu in, “Na min bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Kote tampi ka hih uh ciangin, ka min un Legion ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua gam sung panin amaute a hawlkhiat loh nadingin nakpi-in a thuum uh hi.
Tua san tak mual tungah vok honpi khat gamta-in a om uh hi.
Dawite in, “Kote tua vokte sungah ka lut nadingun vok hon lakah hong paisak in,” ci-in a ngen uh hi.
Zeisu in thu a piak ciangin kihhuai dawite paikhia uh a, vokte sungah a lut uh leh, vok honpite kensang tung pan taisukin tuili sungah a si khin uh hi. Vokte kisim leh, tulnih bang pha ding hi.
Vokcingte tai uh a, khua sung leh gam sungah hih thu a gen uh ciangin, mite in bang thu a piang hiam ci-in en dingin a kuankhia uh hi.
Amaute Zeisu kiang a tun’ uh ciangin Legion a nei dawi lutpa in puan silhin, lungpilte bangin tu-in a om a muh uh ciangin a kihta uh hi.
A mu mite in dawi lutpa ahi zongin, vokte ahi zongin, bangci a piang ci-in amaute a zaksak uh ciangin,
amaute’ gam panin Zeisu paikhia dingin a ngen uh hi.
Zeisu in gunkuang ah a kah lai takin, dawi lutpa in amah tawh omkhawm nading thu a nget ciangin,

Zeisu in thu pia loin, “Na innah ciah in la, Pasian in nangma tungah bangzah takin noptuamna hong pia a, nangma tungah bangci a hehpihna hong pia hiam cih na behte kiangah na zasak in,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Tua pa pai-in Zeisu in bangzah tak noptuamna ama tungah bawl hiam ci-in Dekapolis gamah thu zeelsak a, mi khempeuhte in lamdang a sa uh hi.
Zeisu in gunkuang sungah tuang a, a galkah khit ciangin tuili geiah a om lai takin, mihonpi a kiangah kikhawm uh hi.
Tua lai takin Jairas a min nei, kikhopna inn ukpa khat in va nai a, Zeisu a muh ciangin a khe kiangah bokin,
“Ka tanu a si dektak zo hi. Topa hong pai-in, damkik a, a hin’ theih nadingin ama tungah na khut ngak nadingin kong ngen hi,” ci-in a thuum hi.
Zeisu in tua pa tawh paikhawm a, mi tampite in a nung zui-in a phukha uh hi.
Tua lai takin kum sawm leh kum nih tawntung si luang cinatna vei a,
zato tampi khut tungah gimna tampi thuak a, a neihsa teng bei-in a noptuam lo tham loin a gim semsem numei khat in;
Zeisu thu a zak ciangin, “Ama puan bek lawng kha leng ka dam ding hi,” ci-in mihonpi lakah a nung lamah pai-in, a puan a lawng hi.
Thakhatin a si luang kang a, a cinatna dam pah hi ci-in a pum sungah a thei hi.
Zeisu in ama tung pan vangliatna paikhia a theih khit ciangin, mihonpi lamah kihei a, “Ka puan kua in lawng hiam?” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, “Mi tampi in Topa hong phukha na mu napi-in, ‘Kua in hong lawng hiam?’ ci-in na dong hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in a lawng pen a muh nadingin a kimkot a en hi.
Numei in amahmah tungah bang thu a piang cih thei ahih ciangin lau-in liing a, Zeisu kiangah pai-in a thu khempeuh tel takpi-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang hong damsak zo hi. Nuam takin na ciah in, na cidam ta in,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in tua thu a gen lai takin, kikhopna ukpa’ inn panin mite hong pai uh a, “Na tanu a si zo hi. Siapa bang dingin na gimsak lai ding hiam?” ci-in a ko uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in tua thu mang loin, “Lungmang kei in, upna bek nei in,” ci-in kikhopna inn ukpa kiangah a gen hi.
Zeisu in Piter, Jakob leh Jakob’ nau Johante longal midang kuamah zuih nadingin thu a pia kei hi.
Kikhopna inn ukpa’ inn a tun’ uh ciangin gamlum leh mi tampi kap a, thuum a om uh a mu hi.
Inn sungah a lut ciangin, “Bang hangin gamlum a, kapin om na hi uh hiam? Numeino a si hi lo hi, a ihmu hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mite in zahpihin a nuihsan uh ciangin Zeisu in amaute khempeuh hawlkhia a, numeino’ pa leh a nu tawh amah tawh a omkhawm mite a sap khit ciangin numeino’ omna phualah tum a,
a khut lenin, “Talitha kumi,’ a ci hi. A khiatna in, “Numeino aw, tho in kong ci hi,” a cihnopna hi.
Thakhatin numeino tho pah a, kalsuan hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in kum sawm leh kum nih a pha zo hi. Amaute in thakhatin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Tua thu kuamah in a theih loh nadingin Zeisu in amaute nakpi-in a kham khit ciangin, numeino an piak dingin thu a pia hi.
